description: Mark a visit done, with an optional note. The worker on the visit (or the office) can do this. A visit not yet started is started too. Refused with checklist_open while a checklist on the visit has required items open or a sign-off missing; the owner, signed in on the hosted override page (/p/checklist/override), may pass override_reason to mark it done anyway (recorded and audited). Agents, keys and office staff cannot override.

override_reason.description: Owner in person only (hosted override page): why the visit is done with checklist work left.

name: visits_done

next_actions.description: Useful next steps to offer, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one.
